feed.title: Past The Label — top value wines
feed.subtitle: This week's best-value bottles at Arrowine and The Wine Cabinet.

entry.title: Champagne Egly-Ouriet Grand Cru Blanc de Noirs NV — 87/100 Elite
entry.summary: 87/100 · Elite · $370 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling grower Champagnes in existence, and the price, while steep, is genuinely hard to argue with given what's in the bottle.

entry.title: Tenuta Delle Terre Nere Calderara Etna Rosso Grand Cru Sottana 2023 — 84/100 Elite
entry.summary: 84/100 · Elite · $90 · Arrowine & Cheese, Italy — One of the most compelling buys in this batch despite the $90 price — Terre Nere's Calderara Sottana is a genuine single-vineyard grand cru on Mount Etna's volcanic basalt soils, and there is no realistic lower-priced substitute for this terroir.

entry.title: Blandy's 10 Year Old Bual Madeira 750 ml — 82/100 Elite
entry.summary: 82/100 · Elite · $65 · Arrowine & Cheese, Portugal — A serious buy for anyone who wants to explore one of the world's most distinctive wine styles at a fair price.

entry.title: Champagne Tarlant La Vigne d'Antan Brut Nature Blanc de Blancs 2006 — 82/100 Elite
entry.summary: 82/100 · Elite · $330 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A truly exceptional bottle — and arguably the more intellectually interesting of the two Tarlants at this price.

entry.title: Champagne Jacques Lassaigne "Les Vignes de Montgueux" Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut NV — 80/100 Elite
entry.summary: 80/100 · Elite · $95 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most exciting grower Champagnes available at this price — Emmanuel Lassaigne is a cult figure for a reason, and this wine justifies the hype.

entry.title: Blandy's Madeira Terrantez Vintage 1987 — 79/100 Elite
entry.summary: 79/100 · Elite · $450 · Arrowine & Cheese — One of the genuinely irreplaceable bottles in this batch, and the price is easy to justify.

entry.title: Luna Beberide "Finca Luna Beberide" 2020 — 78/100 Elite
entry.summary: 78/100 · Elite · $30 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — A standout value — estate-grown Mencía from a top Bierzo producer at a price that still carries no prestige premium.

entry.title: Weingut Spreitzer Rheingau Oestricher Lenchen Riesling Kabinett 2022 — 78/100 Elite
entry.summary: 78/100 · Elite · $30 · Arrowine & Cheese, Germany — A textbook argument for why German Kabinett is one of wine's great under-appreciated formats — and this one comes from a documented, serious site.

entry.title: Birichino Mokelumne River Cinsault Bechthold Vineyard "Vignes Centenaires" 2023 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $35 · Arrowine & Cheese, California — Buy this immediately — it's one of the most distinctive value wines on the list.

entry.title: R López de Heredia Viña Cubillo Rioja Crianza 2018 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $40 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — One of the best value buys in the shop, full stop.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo 'Monvigliero' 2020 — 77/100 Elite
entry.summary: 77/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — The most compelling of the three Vietti Barolos at this price, and the one I'd buy first.

entry.title: Les Foulards Rouges "La Soif du Mal" RED 2023 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $40 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A serious buy for the adventurous drinker who wants Grenache that tastes like it came from somewhere specific.

entry.title: Domaine Diochon Moulin-a-Vent Vieilles Vignes 2023 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $35 · Arrowine & Cheese, Beaujolais — One of the best buys in this batch.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Les Ursules" Blanc de Noirs 2020 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling grower Champagnes made today, though you are paying for it — this is a specialist purchase, not an everyday splurge.

entry.title: Domaine du Cros Marcillac Lo Sang del Païs Rosé 2025 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $19 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuinely interesting rosé and one of the stronger buys in this batch.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo 'Cerequio' 2020 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — A serious buy for anyone building a cellar.

entry.title: Champagne Tarlant Vigne d'Or Blanc de Meuniers Brut Nature 2006 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $200 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — 100% Pinot Meunier single-vineyard Champagne from a 2006 vintage is an exceptionally rare thing — Meunier is almost never treated as a prestige variety, let alone isolated in a single-vineyard bottling with this kind of age.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Côte de Val Vilaine" Blanc de Noirs 2022 — 75/100 Elite
entry.summary: 75/100 · Elite · $230 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A genuinely compelling buy if you can stomach the price — Cédric Bouchard is one of the most serious grower-Champagne producers alive, making single-vineyard, single-variety, single-year wines from the Côte des Bar with zero dosage and a relentless focus on terroir.

entry.title: Tenuta delle Terre Nere Etna Rosso San Lorenzo 2023 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $90 · Arrowine & Cheese, Italy — The calibration anchor for this framework at this price, and it earns that status.

entry.title: Domaine Clape Saint Peray Blanc 2022 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $100 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuine buy for anyone who loves serious Northern Rhône whites — Clape is one of the benchmark estates of the appellation, and this vintage now includes a parcel of 70-year-old Marsanne that meaningfully lifts the wine.

entry.title: Tempier Bandol “La Tourtine” 2023 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $110 · Arrowine & Cheese, bandol — One of the most singular red wines in France at any price, and the price here is as good as you'll find it.

entry.title: Champagne Jerome Prévost La Closerie "Les Béguines" Extra Brut LC23 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $370 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most distinctive grower Champagnes in the world, and the price — while steep — is genuinely hard to argue with given what's in the bottle.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo Lazzarito 2020 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $260 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — The more structured, austere sibling to the Cerequio — and a compelling buy for a patient cellar.

entry.title: Champagne Roses de Jeanne "Les Ursules" Blanc de Noirs 2021 — 74/100 Elite
entry.summary: 74/100 · Elite · $400 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the most compelling arguments for $400 Champagne you'll find.

entry.title: Venus La Universal Dido 2021 750ml — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $30 · The Wine Cabinet — A genuine standout at $30 — Venus La Universal is one of Montsant's benchmark producers, and Dido is their serious entry-level blend built on granite soils with a clear terroir philosophy.

entry.title: Adami Vigneto Giardino 2023 750ml — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $28 · The Wine Cabinet, Italy , Veneto — Adami's Vigneto Giardino is one of Prosecco Superiore's benchmark single-vineyard Conegliano Valdobbiadene cuvées — a genuinely different animal from the generic Prosecco category.

entry.title: Champagne Rene Geoffroy Brut 1er Cru "Expression" NV — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $80 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A genuine grower Champagne worth buying despite the price.

entry.title: Torbreck Hillside Vineyard Grenache 2021 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $90 · Arrowine & Cheese, Australia — A serious buy for old-vine Barossa Grenache at the single-vineyard level — this is the kind of bottle that justifies the $90 price tag.

entry.title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello 2020 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $150 · Arrowine & Cheese, Brunello — A serious buy for anyone who wants genuine Brunello at this price point.

entry.title: Domaine Philémon Gaillac Perlé Nature 2024 — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $18 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A strong buy at this price and an easy recommendation for anyone willing to look past the familiar.

entry.title: Taylor Fladgate Vintage Port 2003 750ml — 73/100 Elite
entry.summary: 73/100 · Elite · $150 · The Wine Cabinet — A serious, age-worthy Vintage Port from one of the great names in the Douro — the 2003 was a legendary, scorching vintage that produced concentrated, powerful wines with decades of runway, and Taylor Fladgate is among the handful of shippers who still farm and declare at the highest level.

entry.title: Remelluri Rioja Reserva 2016 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $53 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — One of the strongest buys in this batch — a serious, Atlantic-style Rioja Reserva from a genuine estate at a price that still leaves room.

entry.title: Brij Wines Phelan Farm SLO Coast Chardonnay 2024 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $33 · Arrowine & Cheese, California — A standout value Chardonnay from one of California's most exciting coastal AVAs.

entry.title: Domaine Sérol Côte Roannaise Les Blondins 2023 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $32 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuine standout at this price — Côte Roannaise Gamay on volcanic granite is one of the Loire's best-kept secrets.

entry.title: Feudo Montoni Nero d'Avola Lagnusa 2022 750ml — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $30 · The Wine Cabinet, Italy , Sicily — A strong buy at $30 — this is exactly the kind of wine the framework is built to find.

entry.title: Bérêche & Fils Champagne Brut Réserve NV — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $100 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — One of the best grower Champagnes available under $100 — buy it without hesitation if you're in the market for serious bubbles.

entry.title: Domaine Vincent Paris "Selection" Syrah VdP Collines Rhodaniennes 2024 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $27 · Arrowine & Cheese, Cotes du Rhone — A strong buy — this is a declassified Syrah from a Cornas-native grower whose family vines include 100-year-old stock inherited from his grandfather, and who also farms parcels rented from Robert Michel, one of Cornas's legendary old-school vignerons.

entry.title: Friedrich Wilhelm Gymnasium Schiefer Mosel Riesling 2018 750ml — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $24 · The Wine Cabinet — A strong buy — Friedrich Wilhelm Gymnasium is one of the Mosel's historic estates, and "Schiefer" literally means slate, the blue-grey Devonian slate that gives Mosel Riesling its electric tension and mineral backbone.

entry.title: Vietti Barolo 2021 750ml — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $80 · The Wine Cabinet — A very strong buy for a lover of serious Barolo — Vietti is among the handful of Langhe producers that genuinely define the appellation, and this village-level Barolo (a blend across their Castiglione Falletto and Langa holdings) represents their winemaking philosophy at an accessible entry point.

entry.title: Château Pradeaux Bandol Rosé 2025 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $40 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A strong buy for anyone who takes rosé seriously as a food wine rather than a summer sipper.

entry.title: Conterno Fantino Mosconi Vigna Ped Barolo 2015 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $170 · Arrowine & Cheese, Barolo — A serious buy for the Barolo collector.

entry.title: Fontodi "Flaccianello Della Pieve" 2018 — 72/100 Elite
entry.summary: 72/100 · Elite · $230 · Arrowine & Cheese, Chianti — A serious buy for anyone who wants top-tier Tuscan Sangiovese outside the Brunello price bracket.

entry.title: Benedicte et Stephane Tissot Arbois Chardonnay Patchwork 2023 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $50 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — One of the most interesting Chardonnays available at this price — a strong buy for anyone who finds white Burgundy compelling but blanches at the price.

entry.title: Tempier Bandol “La Migoua” 2023 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $110 · Arrowine & Cheese, bandol — A genuinely exciting Bandol single-vineyard rosé — sorry, red — from one of the most legendary estates in southern France, but the 2023 vintage at $110 is a steep ask for a wine that really needs time.

entry.title: Domaine du Pas Saint Martin "Jurassique" Saumur Blanc 2022 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $35 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuinely compelling buy — one of the better Chenin Blancs at this price in the market.

entry.title: Champagne Michel Turgy Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Reserve Selection — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $60 · Arrowine & Cheese, Champagne — A serious grower Champagne from one of the Côte des Blancs' quieter but most credible families, and a genuine buy at $60 for what it delivers.

entry.title: Weingut Proidl Senftenberg Riesling Alte Reben 2023 750ml — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $38 · The Wine Cabinet — A serious buy — Weingut Proidl is a benchmark producer in Kremstal, and the Senftenberg is one of the most respected single-village sites in the appellation, planted on primary rock and gneiss soils that give Austrian Riesling its characteristic mineral spine.

entry.title: Francois Chidaine Montlouis Brut Tradition — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $32 · Arrowine & Cheese, France — A genuinely exciting sparkling Chenin at a price that's hard to argue with.

entry.title: Bodegas Epifanio Rivera "Erial" 2023 — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $22 · Arrowine & Cheese, Spain — Strong value from a family producer with genuine roots in Pesquera de Duero — the epicenter of serious Ribera del Duero — and documented old vines between 30 and 60 years.

entry.title: Marchesi de' Frescobaldi Chianti Classico Tenuta Perano 2021 750ml — 71/100 Elite
entry.summary: 71/100 · Elite · $25 · The Wine Cabinet, Italy , Tuscany , Chianti Classico — A standout value — single-estate Chianti Classico from a Frescobaldi-owned property at $25 is genuinely hard to beat.
